protocol.rounding: Python round(float_score, decimal_places); binary-float ties follow Python round semantics
protocol.unit: already eligible event candidate in a successful saved video prediction
protocol.video_score: max(rounded event scores), default zero for no eligible events
protocol.threshold_fit: Same evaluate.py 20 linear quantiles j/19, same leave-group-out folds and tie breaking
protocol.raw_files: read only; rounded predictions exist only in memory and their hash is recorded
protocol.interpretation: Report whether method ranking and decisions depend on numerical near-ties. Do not choose a precision to improve quality or replace frozen primary results.

primary_dataset.representative_policy: lexicographically smallest video_id per sha256, chosen without predictions

limitations: This is a post-hoc sensitivity diagnostic with precisions frozen before F1/A1 outcomes; it is not primary model selection.
Rounding may collapse quantile candidates and change threshold tie breaking. This is the tested sensitivity, not a correction to published scores.
Same source-label and filming-session-independence limitations apply to all variants.
A changed ranking does not identify a model/kernel root cause or prove differences in visual understanding.
